```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  }

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

check_file <- function(file, description) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(description, " not found:\n", file)
  }
}

read_feature_table <- function(file, feature_name = "pre_miRNA") {
  check_file(file, "Input table")

  x <- read.csv(
    file,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  candidates <- c(
    feature_name,
    "pre_miRNA",
    "pre_mirna",
    "miRNA",
    "mirna",
    "Gene",
    "gene",
    "X",
    "...1"
  )

  found <- candidates[candidates %in% names(x)]

  if (length(found) > 0) {
    names(x)[names(x) == found[1]] <- feature_name
  } else {
    if (ncol(x) < 2) {
      stop("Could not identify the pre-miRNA column in: ", file)
    }
    names(x)[1] <- feature_name
  }

  x[[feature_name]] <- trimws(as.character(x[[feature_name]]))

  x <- x[
    !is.na(x[[feature_name]]) & nzchar(x[[feature_name]]),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  tibble::as_tibble(x)
}

read_stability_table <- function(file, dataset_name) {
  tab <- read_feature_table(file, "pre_miRNA")

  contrast_candidates <- c(
    "Contrast", "contrast", "Comparison", "comparison"
  )

  contrast_column <- contrast_candidates[
    contrast_candidates %in% names(tab)
  ]

  if (length(contrast_column) == 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table has no contrast column: ",
      file
    )
  }

  names(tab)[names(tab) == contrast_column[1]] <- "Contrast"

  required_columns <- c(
    "Contrast",
    "pre_miRNA",
    params$stability_flag_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(tab))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  tab %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Contrast = as.character(Contrast),
      pre_miRNA = as.character(pre_miRNA),
      bootstrap_stable = as_flag(
        .data[[params$stability_flag_column]]
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      Contrast,
      pre_miRNA,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
}

read_primary_de <- function(
    de_dir,
    stability_table,
    dataset_name,
    source_contrast,
    display_contrast,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  de_file <- file.path(
    de_dir,
    paste0(source_contrast, ".csv")
  )

  df <- read_feature_table(
    de_file,
    feature_name = "pre_miRNA"
  )

  required_de_columns <- c(
    "pre_miRNA",
    "logFC",
    "FDR"
  )

  missing_de_columns <- setdiff(
    required_de_columns,
    names(df)
  )

  if (length(missing_de_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " DE file ",
      basename(de_file),
      " is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_de_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pre_miRNA = as.character(pre_miRNA),
      logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR)
    )

  if (flip_logfc) {
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(logFC = -logFC)
  }

  stability_for_contrast <- stability_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast == source_contrast
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pre_miRNA,
      bootstrap_stable
    )

  if (nrow(stability_for_contrast) == 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": no stability records found for contrast ",
      source_contrast,
      "."
    )
  }

  df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      stability_for_contrast,
      by = "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      
      fdr_significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff,

      bootstrap_stable = dplyr::coalesce(
        bootstrap_stable,
        FALSE
      ),

      stable_significant =
        fdr_significant & bootstrap_stable,

      status = dplyr::case_when(
        stable_significant & logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        stable_significant & logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        fdr_significant & !bootstrap_stable ~
          "FDR significant, not bootstrap-stable",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),

      status = factor(
        status,
        levels = status_levels
      ),

      neglog10FDR = -log10(
        pmax(FDR, 1e-300)
      ),

      dataset = dataset_name,
      source_contrast = source_contrast,
      contrast = display_contrast
    )
}
```

```{r}
plot_volcano_stability <- function(
    df,
    title,
    output_stub,
    label_n = params$label_n
) {
  label_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(stable_significant) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      FDR,
      dplyr::desc(abs(logFC))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = label_n)

  
  
  nonsig_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(status == "Not significant")

  unstable_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      status == "FDR significant, not bootstrap-stable"
    )

  stable_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(stable_significant)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = logFC,
      y = neglog10FDR
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = nonsig_df,
      ggplot2::aes(color = status),
      alpha = 0.55,
      size = 1.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = unstable_df,
      ggplot2::aes(color = status),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 1.45
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = stable_df,
      ggplot2::aes(color = status),
      alpha = 0.85,
      size = 1.55
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(params$fdr_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      ggplot2::aes(label = pre_miRNA),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.20,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      seed = 20260810
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = status_colors,
      breaks = status_levels,
      limits = status_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = expression(log[2] * " fold-change"),
      y = expression(-log[10]("FDR"))
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9)
    )

  svg_file <- file.path(
    plot_dir,
    paste0(output_stub, ".svg")
  )

  pdf_file <- file.path(
    plot_dir,
    paste0(output_stub, ".pdf")
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = svg_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 5.6,
    device = "svg"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = pdf_file,
    plot = p,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 5.6,
    device = grDevices::cairo_pdf
  )

  p
}
```
